column3: 少し遅れてマジックが率いるゼス本国軍６千が戦場に到着した

column4: Ah, the Zeth folks seemed to detest us because magic doesn't work on us,

column4: but there are actually many cute people. I kind of like them now.

column4: Hannies wandering around Magic-look, this person is the chairman, the chairman.

ふざけないで戦争中なのよ、貴方たちの仲間も今戦っているのでしょ、早く戦場に
column4: Don't joke around; we are in the middle of a war. Your comrades are fighting now too, so get to the battlefield quickly.
